# Shoppers manage their cart

## Description

A shopper adds and removes items and the total follows.

## Outcome

The cart total is always right.

## Requirements

R1: A shopper can add an item to the cart.
R2: A shopper learns which payment provider fits.

## Boundaries

- Must not change: product pages
